# Iter 2 — 2017-bull+2018-bear (re-run with Binance data)

> **Date:** 2026-04-09
> **Period:** 2017-01-01 → 2018-12-31 (formation cycle)
> **Command:** `python scripts/theory_backtest.py --period 2017-bull+2018-bear --coins "BTC ETH"`
> **Raw output:** `docs/analysis/raw/backtest_2017-bull+2018-bear_20260409T100953Z.json`
> **Blocker removed:** data loader now falls back to Binance REST klines
> (commit `fc66419`), so 4H/1H coverage for BTC and ETH is available from
> ~2017-08-17 onward.

---

## Signals generated by the theory

BTC and ETH both ran the full weekly → 1H pipeline for the first time.

| Coin | TF     | Signals | Correct | Incorrect | Accuracy |
| ---- | ------ | ------- | ------- | --------- | -------- |
| BTC  | Weekly | 105     | 12      | 3         | 80.0%    |
| BTC  | Daily  | 105     | 46      | 15        | 75.4%    |
| BTC  | 4H     | 46      | 12      | 33        | 26.7%    |
| BTC  | 1H     | 16      | 12      | 3         | 80.0%    |
| ETH  | Weekly | 105     | 13      | 10        | 56.5%    |
| ETH  | Daily  | 105     | 48      | 16        | 75.0%    |
| ETH  | 4H     | 48      | 13      | 33        | 28.3%    |
| ETH  | 1H     | 25      | 13      | 11        | 54.2%    |

Top failure patterns (combined):

1. `4H setup invalid after daily confirm` — **×53** (dominant).
2. `entry triggered but TP not reached` — ×13.
3. `1H entry did not trigger` — ×1.

## Correct calls and misses

When a 1H entry actually fired, BTC converted 12/15 = 80% of triggers into
TP hits — an **encouraging signal that the weekly→daily bias layers and the
1H entry mechanics are sound**. ETH's 1H conversion was weaker (13/24 ≈ 54%),
consistent with the Phase 1 ETH COT caveat and the much higher volatility
of ETH during the ICO boom-bust.

Example wins on BTC (first seven 4H entries):

| Date       | Direction | Entry   | SL      | TP      | Result    |
| ---------- | --------- | ------- | ------- | ------- | --------- |
| 2017-10-09 | long      | 4610    | 4435    | 4960    | correct   |
| 2017-10-30 | long      | 6101    | 5648    | 7006    | correct   |
| 2017-11-20 | long      | 8048    | 7650    | 8842    | correct   |
| 2017-11-27 | long      | 9500    | 8605    | 11291   | correct   |
| 2017-12-04 | long      | 11233   | 10500   | 12698   | correct   |
| 2017-12-11 | long      | 15312   | 12368   | 21200   | **WRONG** |
| 2018-01-15 | short     | 13690   | 14340   | 12391   | correct   |

The **2017-12-11 chase long at $15,312** is the single clearest loser — a
continuation entry into the ATH print, SL pushed to $12,368 which was
swept in the January crash. The system was still in "long bias" because
weekly and daily MAs lag terminal impulses. (Iter 3+ should revisit this
with an explicit terminal-phase rule.)

The dominant failure, though, is not the losers — it is the **53 weeks
where the daily bias was confirmed but the 4H setup check rejected the
week**. That is the subject of this iteration's theory improvement.

## What changed and why

**One concrete theory improvement:** added
`top_down_timeframe_execution.pipeline.four_hour.counter_move_is_the_setup`
to `docs/technical.yaml`. The section states, in one place, that once
the daily bias is confirmed, a 4H move AGAINST the daily direction is
the EXPECTED setup condition (it is the pullback) — not an invalidation.

### Why this is the right first theory improvement for period 1

The backtest's biggest failure bucket is "4H setup invalid after daily
confirm" at 53 occurrences — more than 4× the number of actual losing
trades (13). Every one of those 53 cases is a week where the weekly and
daily layers aligned with institutional bias correctly, but the naive
trend-matching heuristic on the 4H rejected the setup because price was
in a counter-daily pullback. Those are precisely the pullbacks that the
Phase 1-added `entry_triggers_4h.retroceso_75_setup`,
`entry_triggers_4h.block_rejection_plus_bos`, and
`entry_triggers_4h.pfq_fractalico` patterns are designed to exploit.

The gap in the theory was that `top_down_timeframe_execution` never
explicitly said "counter-move is the setup". The Phase 1 additions
implied it through the 4H triggers, but a straightforward reader — or
a straightforward code implementation like `_four_h_setup` in
`scripts/theory_backtest.py` — can easily read the pipeline as "4H must
agree with daily direction" and throw away every pullback.

### The new section spells out, in one place

- The rule: counter-daily 4H move is the pullback, not an invalidation.
- The rationale: links directly to the 53/94 rejection rate observed in
  this backtest.
- A how-to-apply block with three cases per direction: pullback (enter
  on structural trigger), impulse without pullback (stand aside), and
  true invalidation (multi-swing break + confluence close beyond).
- A pullback-vs-invalidation distinction with explicit criteria, so the
  decision is testable.
- A `note_for_engines` block telling any backtest engine or strategy
  implementation **not** to use a trend-MA check on the 4H — the
  direction of the 4H itself is irrelevant once daily is confirmed; the
  only valid 4H validity check is "inside a confluence zone AND a
  structural element has printed".

No other sections were modified in this commit. Existing
`entry_triggers_4h` patterns are untouched — they are pointed to from
the new section but remain the authoritative definitions of each
pattern.

## 4H/1H execution notes

- When the 1H entry **did fire**, it converted at 80% on BTC and 54% on
  ETH — the weekly→daily→1H chain works. The leak is the 4H filter layer.
- Several of the true losers clustered around the 2018-01 top tick and
  again in 2018-11 (capitulation bounce failed longs). These are terminal
  expansion entries — a probable candidate for iter 3+.
- The 2018-Q3 chop produced multiple "entry triggered but TP not reached"
  results — a candidate for a range-vs-trend classifier improvement in a
  later iteration, but not today.
- Pre-2017-08-17 is still a data gap (Binance BTCUSDT / ETHUSDT did not
  exist yet). The effective backtest window for period 1 is
  2017-08-17 → 2018-12-31. Logged and accepted.

## Next period

Iter 3 → `2019-recovery` (2019-01-01 → 2019-12-31). With Binance data
live, this is the first clean full-period backtest.
